evidence.curator_note: THIS RECORD IS THE SECOND BRANCH of Equation 8.106, the one printed after the word 'or'. The single precursor is drawn once: A bonded to B, D bonded to C, B and C joined by the U-arc that stands for the rest of the ion, and '+(.)' above D. The 're' arrow leads to two alternative product sets - branch 1 (record IMS8-EQ8.106a) writes 'A-D' with '+(.)' above D plus the cyclized 'B-C' fragment; branch 2, encoded here, writes the SAME two fragments but with '+(.)' printed above the C of the cyclized B-C fragment, i.e. the charge is retained by the ejected interior ring instead of by the A-D molecule. The bond changes are identical in both branches (A-B and C-D break, A-D and B-C form); only the charge location differs, which is the classic charge-retention/charge-migration alternative. ARC COUNT (convention D): Book draws 0 arc(s) - the page prints no curved arrows or fishhooks anywhere in 8.106. All five moves are curator-supplied to make the drawn products electron-balanced. Four of them are the same homolytic bookkeeping as in branch 1 (each breaking bond feeds the two forming bonds); the fifth, move <2>, is the one that produces THIS branch rather than branch 1: one electron of a lone pair on the interior heteroatom completes the new A-D bond, so the hole (charge + odd electron) ends up on the interior ring while D leaves neutral, and move <5> returns the second electron of the breaking C-D bond to D so that it closes its shell. A charge migration of this kind is unavoidable in branch 2: a pure two-bonds-in/two-bonds-out rearrangement necessarily leaves the charge on D, so the book's 'or' is a statement about which fragment holds the charge (decided by ionization energies), not about a different arrow pattern. ARROW-CHECK NOTE: the deterministic checker compares predicted non-bonding electrons with RDKit radical counts, and a one-electron hole reads as +1 radical while the arrows record -1 electron, so it emits two '(soft) ... consistent with a lone pair rather than radicals' advisories for atoms 3 and 7; those are the charge-migration moves, and they are intended. INSTANTIATION (convention F): the page prints no m/z and no intensity. Same precursor as record IMS8-EQ8.106a - the 1-ethoxy-3-methoxypropane molecular ion CH3CH2-O-CH2CH2CH2-O(+.)-CH3 (C6H14O2, m/z 118.0983), chosen because it gives BOTH branches a localizable charge site on oxygen. Branch 2 ejects neutral dimethyl ether (46.0419) and keeps the charge on the cyclized interior fragment, the tetrahydrofuran radical cation (m/z 72.0564). LOCALIZATION (convention B): the precursor carries the charge and odd electron explicitly on the methoxy oxygen ([O+:7], the atom the book marks '+(.)'), and the product ion carries them explicitly on the ring oxygen ([O+:3] with two bonds = one unpaired electron in RDKit). MS context is taken from the page's own closing paragraph: 'molecular ions formed by 70-eV electron ionization'.

NO LIVE MØD rule is cross-linked; rule_index.json has no '8.106' key. The only rule in the code base for this reaction is DISABLED: IMS_bookCover.py lines 438-451, 'elimination = mod.Rule.fromDFS( # siehe Tab. 8.4 ... "[_A]1[C]2" "." "[C]3[_A+]4[_A]5" >> "[C]2" "." "[C]3{-}2.[_A]1[_A]4[_A+]5" ...)', carrying the comment '# TODO: check if elimination is correct, verify with book' and commented out together with its '# elimination,' entry in the rearrangements list. CHECKED against the page: its bond bookkeeping reproduces 8.106 (A1-C2 and C3-A4 cleaved; C2-C3 and A1-A4 formed), but it cannot represent THIS branch at all - its charge stays on the ejected A1-A4-A5 fragment (moving only from A4 to the substituent A5), never on the cyclized interior fragment, whereas branch 2 is defined by the charge being on the ring. It also (i) has a two-component, i.e. bimolecular, left side while 8.106 is intramolecular, and (ii) is even-electron only, while the page's '+(.)' notation covers odd-electron ions such as the one instantiated here. Listed in rule_mismatches. No other rule in src/data_generation/rules/ breaks two bonds and forms two bonds in one step.

NO MEASUREMENT ON THE PAGE (convention F): Equation 8.106 is drawn with letters only and page 213 prints no m/z and no abundance. m/z 72.0564 (C4H8O+., the tetrahydrofuran radical cation) is curator-computed with RDKit ExactMolWt, electron-mass corrected, for the chosen instantiation (precursor 118.0983, neutral dimethyl ether 46.0419).
